system.one_liner: Empirical study of 19 visual recognition models from five architecture families on four federated datasets with heterogeneous client data.

content.variant_note: two bands: four dataset columns with real distribution plots and sample images, then five architecture-family boxes listing model names
content.argues: The study spans four federated datasets of differing heterogeneity and every major visual architecture family, so architecture choice can be examined as a lever against data heterogeneity.
content.subject: Four federated datasets (class distribution per client plus image samples) feeding into 19 models grouped in five architecture families.

lessons.what_to_learn: Tell the scope of a benchmark study in two bands: one identical mini-card per dataset showing its real statistics plus thumbnails, then one arrow to a band of model-family boxes that list their members.
lessons.suits: Empirical studies that cross a data axis with a model axis, where the diversity or skew of the data is part of the message.

evidence: Our study, comprehensively illustrated in Figure 1, embodies a step toward more efficient, practical, and robust FL systems.
We study 19 visual recognition models from five different architectural families on four challenging FL datasets.

summary: The paper studies how architecture choice affects federated visual recognition under non-IID client data. Figure 1 is a scope card in two bands. The top blue band has four dataset columns (CIFAR-10, CelebA, Fed-ISIC2019, GLD-23K), each with its class and client counts, a bitmap plot of the real client-by-class distribution and a mosaic of sample photos. A fat brown arrow leads to a green dashed band with five tinted boxes, one per architecture family (CNN, Transformers, MLP Mixers, Hybrids, MetaFormers), listing the 19 models. It is flat vector, serif, with thick black outlines and small text.

notes: Caption also mentions four optimisation methods used orthogonally to architecture; they are not drawn in the figure. Prior pre-screen listed 4 dataset cards plus family boxes; kept scope-overview / benchmark-dashboard.
